what: 3.2 Rule catalogue (everything handled in the project)
title: Plan: a jurisdiction-agnostic R package for plan-enabled capacity
text: Neutral names first, NZ term brackets. Every rule accepts source, variant, activity_status conditions (3.3). Height storeys - height_limit(value, occupiable, roof_allowance, storeys) — total vs occupiable height (HVC lesson: mapped height includes roof form). - Storey heights: default, ground-floor height, per-zone; storey count derived occupiable / intended storeys, never flat 3 m. - no_limit_stand_in zones height limit, flagged upper bound. - Absolute height limits (RL datum) well -ground. Setbacks (yards) — boundary class: road, side, rear, internal, common, coastal, riparian, lakeside, reserve, rail, plus user-defined classes keyed layer. Options: above_storey, max_value, value_from = "existing_average" (special character front yard), water yards measured water layer. Planes (recession plane / height relation boundary / daylight angle / sky exposure plane): angle, start height, set-, boundaries, orientation_graded (angle compass bearing; hemisphere-aware), on_southern_boundary_of_neighbour (generalised facing), exemptions front N m share depth, datum (ground / boundary / site mean), vertical_above, step-back height. Upper-level setbacks: extra setback storey height, per class. Site ratios: building coverage, landscaped area, impervious, paved — single value bands site area; floor area ratio (FAR) max. Building form: max floorplate, max tower floorplate / dimension, tower separation, building length, building separation, gaps height, minimum floorplate (enforced stack), minimum building width, site shape factor (min rectangle). Density: site area per dwelling, dwellings per hectare, minimum site area, vacant site minimum, max dwellings per site, minor dwellings, max / min dwellings across area (precinct totals), large-site rules (threshold, infrastructure deduction, alternative density), access-width table (frontage/accessway width → max dwellings), minimum dwelling size. Use mix: residential enabled, business enabled, residential share floorspace mixed zones (source), max floorspace per site / area. Methods: volumetric (storey stack), density (rule straight dwellings), hybrid (, take lesser). Overlays (spatial layers modify rules), precedence: height_cap, height_override, height_surface (raster/TIN, e.g. airport surfaces, viewshafts, sunlight admission planes), height_bands (mapped height converted via table, HVC case), exclusion (subtract geometry: hazards, designations, water yards), parameter_override (edit named zone parameters, e.g. special character), flag_only. can default_enabled: false switched scenario. Partial coverage: surface caps part site covers (engine item 368, done properly start). Areas (precinct / sub-precinct / specific control / overlay zone): overrides, additions, per-zone overrides, sub-areas keyed field. Zone adjacency: rules switch zone across boundary (business yards planes), zone families set membership. Conversion: floorspace → dwellings (dwelling size, circulation efficiency allowances, minimum-one-dwelling floor), shown every output reports dwellings. Unmodelled rules register: rule, zones, reason, likely effect modelling (overstates / understates / either), size known.

what: 3.5 Combining overlapping rules, and rules from other jurisdictions
title: Plan: a jurisdiction-agnostic R package for plan-enabled capacity
text: Full analysis RULES-RESEARCH.md. summary: Coverage, landscaping impervious limits combine restrictive, additively (capacityengine now). ground budget adds paving development needs (access legs, surface parking, outdoor space per dwelling). three modes: most_restrictive (default), with_access full. Sites slack flagged. ground_overlap: block declares ground may count twice. Seven combination operators: cap, envelope, replace, floor, add, multiply, composite. evaluated fixed order: zone → areas → overlays → bonuses → entitlements. Variants: default site takes maximum permitted variants. Setback profile primitive. Every rule distance boundary becomes d(h) origin line (boundary, far side road, road centreline). New v1: GFA definition; unit mix conversion; parking; coverage height; bonuses reported separately; buffer exclusions trees; minimum floor level. v2 (held rules flagged v1): shadow sunlight; building depth separation packing; outlook; amalgamation.
